title: NULL Handling
description: Work with NULL, IS NULL, IS NOT NULL, COALESCE, and NULLIF.

data.text: NULL represents unknown or missing data. Use IS NULL and IS NOT NULL to test for NULL.

data.title: COALESCE
data.code:
SELECT id, COALESCE(display_name, email, 'Anonymous') AS name
FROM users;

data.title: NULLIF
data.content: Return NULL if values are equal
data.code:
SELECT id, NULLIF(status, '') AS status
FROM orders;

terms.definition: Returns NULL if both arguments are equal.

data.title: Exercise: Normalize Names
data.description: Use COALESCE to choose display name, fallback to email.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use IS NULL and IS NOT NULL.
Use COALESCE and NULLIF for NULL logic.
